name: Christmas Advent Tree
description: A pixel-art Christmas tree that gains a bauble every day of December, with a countdown in sleeps to Christmas. Fully offline, no API key.
author: James Steward

board.title: Board Size
board.description: Which display the tree is drawn for. A Flagship gets one bauble every day; a Note's smaller tree gets one every two or three days.

twinkle.title: Twinkle
twinkle.description: Shuffle the bauble colours at every refresh so the tree twinkles. Makes the board flip more often.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Decides when a new day (and a new bauble) starts.

demo_day.title: Preview Day
demo_day.description: Pretend it is this day of December (1-31) to preview the tree. 0 uses the real date.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often FiestaBoard asks this plugin for data. The tree only changes once a day unless Twinkle is on.

env_vars.name: ADVENT_TIMEZONE
env_vars.description: Timezone override (can also be set in the web UI).

phase.description: Where in the season it is: PRE, ADVENT, XMAS, HOLS (26-31 Dec) or NEWYEAR (1-6 Jan)

sleeps.description: Sleeps (days) until Christmas Day, 0 on and after Christmas

days_to_advent.description: Days until 1 December, before advent starts

count_label.description: SLEEP/SLEEPS or DAY/DAYS to go with the count

headline.description: One-line summary that fits a Flagship row

updated.description: Local time this data was last refreshed, 24-hour

line1.description: Pre-built board row 1 with the tree in colour tiles (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

line2.description: Pre-built board row 2 with the tree in colour tiles (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

line3.description: Pre-built board row 3 with the tree in colour tiles (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

line4.description: Pre-built board row 4 with the tree in colour tiles (Flagship only; blank on a Note) (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

line5.description: Pre-built board row 5 with the tree in colour tiles (Flagship only; blank on a Note) (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)

line6.description: Pre-built board row 6 with the tree in colour tiles (Flagship only; blank on a Note) (characters, not tiles: each {NN} colour code is 4 characters but 1 tile)
